control_boundary: Manual 13 must distinguish binding federal law and SEC rules from SEC guidance, management evaluation responsibilities from external-auditor responsibilities, and the currently effective AS 2201 text from amendments approved but not effective until 2026-12-15. ITGC content must remain anchored to technology controls relevant to ICFR and financially significant systems rather than generic cybersecurity compliance.
